sources.locator: p1 ratings/lead-frame outline/recommended layout; p2 L versus I

requirements.description: Review tolerance and L versus DC current, maximum DCR, actual switching losses and application temperature against exact source.
Review both winding terminals and routed copper/vias for peak/RMS currents, copper thickness, temperature rise and voltage drop.
Review exact pad geometry, stencil, orientation and magnetic coupling to sensitive circuits against manufacturer outline and converter topology.
Validate converter current peaks, inductor current dependence and load/startup/fault transients with configured source and load.
Measure winding current and temperature under maximum permitted duty, source extremes and enclosure conditions.

notes: Bare inductor and source-derived land pattern. Datasheet current figures are not board ampacity or converter qualification.
